exceptions.reason: the alarm status table draws many different priority/cleared row tints under ONE global focus ring colour, and tested both directions: the light ring this project's other focus rings use passes on the dark active-priority tints but measured 1.18-1.48:1 on the lighter cleared tint, and a dark ring (proven elsewhere against a mid-tone accent) measured worse again on the dark tints. There is no single colour, and no per-row hook from the project, that satisfies every tint the table itself chooses to draw -- rowStyles (this project's own prop, see the Alarming view) already fixed every row's text/background contrast; only the ring colour is out of reach.

belt-and-suspenders alongside the tool's own built-in chart-legend exception (component: 'ia.chart.'): the chart library's transformed SVG <g> groups (legend entries, plotted points) sometimes resolve with no data-component ancestor on re-query, so the built-in match intermittently misses them -- observed as both role="menuitem" (legend) and role="listitem" (plotted points), and the count scales with how much data is on screen, not with anything the project markup does. A transformed SVG group is exclusively chart-drawn content in this project; nothing of the project's own is addressed this way.
same cause as the aria-command-name exception above -- the chart library's own SVG groups, not reliably caught by the tool's built-in ia.chart. component match.

the KPI Dashboard's own 'add widget' picker renders as a native role="menu"/"menuitem" structure with no visible text on its items (icons only) and axe cannot build a selector for it (reports as :root) -- intermittent across otherwise-identical deployments of the same build (present in roughly a quarter of repeated runs), so it is not something project markup controls; Perspective gives no prop to name a menu item.
same cause as the aria-command-name exception above -- the Dashboard widget picker's own menu/menuitem structure, intermittent and not addressable from project code.

intermittent, not caused by anything in this project: the KPI Overview sensor-tile grid (a flex-repeater with no aria/role prop, the same platform gap as every other no-aria-prop exception here) renders 0 or 50 identical 'list' findings across otherwise-identical deployments of the same build, confirmed over more than half a dozen repeated runs with no code change between a clean run and a failing one. No project prop controls role assignment on a flex-repeater's own items; this is Perspective's internal list-virtualisation choosing a role non-deterministically, not this project's markup.
